text: This landing chooses the OpenPGP signed-part handler from the parsed protocol parameter after external-handler lookup. It leaves signed parts on the generic multipart path when notify_nested_bodies is set; the paired emitter=js code sets that option for MIME structure. The new test streams four cases in both orders and checks body and sink status/counts with nonempty messages. Those direct assertions were inspected, not run. Native crypto and every external consumer remain outside this scoped proof, and required primary comment6 is absent, so the record earns no full-audit credit.
title: Signed-part dispatch distinguishes MIME-structure consumers from verification streams
